verifications.claim: American Express Platinum Member Airfares was formerly the International Airline Program.

verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state that Platinum Member Airfares replaces the International Airline Program.

verifications.claim: Premium cabin includes First, Business, Premium Economy.
